traces.title: Agent traces / runs
traces.description: One or more trace/run objects. Each item may contain a spans array, or may itself be an OpenTelemetry-style span.

spans.title: OpenTelemetry / GenAI spans
spans.description: Alternative flat span input. Supports common gen_ai.*, llm.*, and OpenInference-style attributes.

highInputTokenThreshold.title: High input-token threshold
highInputTokenThreshold.description: Only used to label token-heavy calls for review; it does not prove waste.
